Messages.Author: Jeff Haar
Messages.Body:
Let's say I influence out Qufur am-Heru and put 2 chimestry discipline
cards on him. Now I play sensory deprivation on Kyle Strathcona.
Following this Arika burns me with protect thine own. Kyle untaps an
normal now. I put Qufur am-Heru back into my uncontrolled region with
his special ability and influence him out.

Does Kyle continue to untap as normal?

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Jeff Haar" <kit3...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:6933e80c.04013...@posting.google.com...


no. the Qufur copy chich previously played the sensory deprivation has left
play at some point. So the card text on sensory deprivation kicks in and
kyle will untap as normal as though he had no sensory dep on him.
See also : sensory dep & banishment, by LSJ.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


If you mean "Yes. The Qufur copy which...", then Correct.

Once deactivated, a Sensory Deprivation never reactivates.
